JKF.notes: Never explained in advisory text; co-tagged with TikTok/BizVibe/B2B Wave/flance on job-task scam sites (coupang-vip.com, wwwshopee.net, bigbuy.rest). No company "JKF" linked to task/e-commerce jobs found (web search 2026-11-26). Could be a fake platform label read from screenshots. Needs human review.

CTX.notes: Not explained in advisory text; scam site ctxpublic.online on crypto-mining investment scams (co-tagged Doge Mining, GN Mall, Coinbase, PUMP MINING, Novartis AG VIP). Could be a fictitious platform or misuse of a ticker (e.g. Cryptex Finance CTX). Unresolved.

JUST.notes: Investment-scam sites usttt.net / uuttt.cc / ustt.work "claim to represent known brands like JUST". Best candidate: JUST (TRON DeFi ecosystem, just.network - opened 2026-11-26), but SPF gives no detail; could be fictitious.

Dell Player.notes: SPF: scammers "falsely claiming association with brands such as Dell Player" (taishang8.top). No product called "Dell Player" exists; either misuse of the Dell name (dell.com) or a fake app name in the media-player-name pattern (cf. GOM Player, MPC-HC, Televizo).

Citadel.notes: Citadel (hedge fund) / Citadel Securities (market maker); typosquat citadiel.com. Both sites behind Cloudflare (403 to curl); domains from established knowledge.

Chan Brothers.notes: SG travel agency (chanbrothers.com.sg redirects to chanbrothers.com). Phishing page sell.sctt.net.

SEI.notes: Named by SPF as a brand linked to suspicious investment site seeee.cc. Candidates: Sei blockchain / SEI token (sei.io, opened 2026-11-26) - most consistent with crypto co-tags - or SEI Investments (seic.com). Unresolved.

Skild AI.notes: Real robotics-AI startup; name misused for fake investment (skdai001.xyz).

Starview.notes: Job-task site starview.cyou; no real company found (web search 2026-11-26). SPF calls it a "legitimate company" but evidence of one is lacking.

GREY.notes: Grey Group advertising agency; fake job "work hub" greygroupworkhub.com.

Coinbase.notes: Typosquat oinbase-staking.com (fake staking). coinbase.com behind Cloudflare (403 to curl); domain from established knowledge.

PUMP MINING.notes: Fake crypto-mining platform (pumpmining.top); not named in body text.

Novartis AG VIP.notes: Fake "VIP" investment scheme built on the Novartis name (herb6.vip). Real-company name cloned by a fake platform.

CNPC.notes: China National Petroleum Corporation; tag not explained in body (themostprofitableapp.us, long-termprojects.us oil-investment lure). cnpc.com.cn answered HTTP 412 to curl; domain from established knowledge.

Virtu.notes: Virtu Financial (market maker); name misused on same fake investment sites as CNPC.

Velo Trust.notes: SPF: sites "impersonating Velo Trust" (velotrust-exchanges.com). A London bitcoin OTC desk/custodian "Velo Trust" appears in old crypto directories (CryptoSlate), status/official domain unverified; could equally be a fictitious platform.

IRUN.notes: iRUN Singapore running-gear retailer; lookalike irunsg.shop.

Motor AI.notes: MOTOR Ai, Berlin autonomous-driving startup; job scam site motorai.net.

Facebook.notes: Meta platform used as a lure brand in job scams. facebook.com returned HTTP 400 to curl; domain from established knowledge.

VanguardETFs.notes: Vanguard (fund manager); fake vanguardetfs.xyz. Tag not named in body text.

GTS.notes: SPF says investment sites (veobike.vip, yushiai.vip) "impersonate legitimate brands like VEO and GTS"; no specific GTS entity identifiable.

VEO.notes: Probably Veo (VeoRide) shared e-bike/scooter operator: scam site veobike.vip fits the "invest in shared bikes" pattern also seen with Lyft Bikes. Low confidence.

Audi Capital.notes: Not explained in body (innovative-finance.cc, nvidialisuj.top). Candidates: Audi Capital, a Riyadh asset manager (search results only, domain unverified), or misuse of the Audi brand. Needs review.

QUALCOMM invest.notes: Fake "QUALCOMM invest" platform (qumbep.net) cloning the Qualcomm name.

Rolex.notes: Luxury brand used in fake investment scheme (zylanto.site). rolex.com blocks curl (403); domain from established knowledge.

Aurum Exchange.notes: SPF lists it among "fake investment platforms" (aurumexchanges.com). A crypto "Aurum Exchange" by Aurum Foundation (aurum.trading) exists per search results but has a mixed reputation and was not verified. Clone vs. fictitious unclear.

BeReal.notes: Typosquat bereall.com used in investment scam.

LdnBit.notes: SPF explicitly calls LdnBit a fake investment platform.

Carousell.notes: SG-HQ classifieds marketplace; "free goods" phishing allfreegoods.shop. carousell.sg/.com behind Cloudflare (403); domains from established knowledge.

MalaysiaArrivalCard.notes: Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC), Immigration Department of Malaysia; free official form at imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac. Fee-charging lookalikes arrivalsmalaysia.com, earrivalform.com.

Web3.0.notes: Generic technology term used as investment lure, not an organisation.

Sentosa.notes: Sentosa Development Corporation (statutory board); lookalike sentosa-sg.com.

Climate Vouchers.notes: Climate Friendly Households Programme (MSE/NEA). Genuine voucher links start with voucher.redeem.gov.sg (RedeemSG). Fake site goov.up.railway.app.

Tiger Brokers.notes: tigerbrokers.com.sg redirects to itiger.com/sg (observed). SG arm Tiger Brokers (Singapore) Pte Ltd; parent UP Fintech. Lookalikes itigereo.top, moomoes.top.

ApMatrix.notes: Not named in body (harmonyreel.net, apxcw.com); no real "ApMatrix" platform found.

Sky Marine Hotel.notes: SPF: "Sky Marine Hotel Singapore is a fraudulent hotel listing" on Google Maps etc. (skymarinehotel.com).

AI Robot.notes: Generic "AI trading robot" descriptor (airobotbep.top), not an organisation.

uSMART.notes: uSMART Securities (Singapore) online broker (parent HK-based); lookalike usmartsg.sg.

MPC-HC.notes: Media Player Classic - Home Cinema, open-source player; maintained fork at github.com/clsid2/mpc-hc. Job-scam site mpc-hc789.shop.

Space Seven.notes: Likely SpaceSeven (SpaceSeven AG, Zug; NFT marketplace built by Tacans; Swiss company register shows it in liquidation 2026). Scam domains spacesevenag.com / spaceiseven.com copy the "Space Seven AG" name. Official domain not verified (presumably spaceseven.com), so entity_id left null.

MedWOW.notes: MedWOW = online marketplace for used medical equipment (NY/Cyprus). Job scam site medwow.cc. www.medwow.com did not respond to curl; domain from search results (Crunchbase/Trustpilot), not opened.

BizVibe.notes: Real B2B marketplace; job-task scams (bigbuy.rest, tiktokvipshops.com, ebayhot.com) cite its name.
